options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Advancement Difficulty
options.doc:
Sets what types of minecraft advancements that will be locations and considered for logic.
valid options for base Minecraft are ["task", "goal", "challenge"]

options.name: Activated Modules
options.doc:
Sets which modules are activated.
valid options are ["Advancements", "FTBQuests", "BetterQuesting"]

options.name: FTB Quest Shapes
options.doc:
Shapes of FTB quests that will be locations and considered for logic.
valid options for base FTB Quests are ["circle", "square", "rsquare", "diamond", "pentagon", "hexagon", "octagon", "heart", "gear", "none"]

options.name: Better Questing Shapes
options.doc:
Shapes of Better Questing quests that will be locations and considered for logic.
valid options for base Better Questing are ["main", "other"]

options.name: Unlock Type
options.doc:
Controls how locations are accessed.
Tab type gives access to a page of advancements/quests at a time.
Tree type gives access to the dependants of an advancements/quests.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle l'accès aux emplacements.
Le type d'onglet donne accès à une page d'avancements/questions à la fois.
Le type d'arbre donne accès aux personnes à charge d'un avancement ou d'une demande.

options.name: End Goal
options.doc:
The Goal of the Randomizer.
Use a custom advancement by using it's resource name ie. "adv minecraft:adventure/adventuring_time (Adventuring Time)"
Format: "<type> <advancement_name|quest_name> (<display_name>)"
type = one of [adv, ftb]

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Start With Roots
options.doc:
With this set to true all checks that don't have any dependencies will be unlocked from the start.
eg. root advancements

options.name: Checks (REQUIRED, check setup guide for how to fill this in)
options.doc:
Advancements and quests from the game.
This is not done manually, check the setup guide.
options.doc_fr:
Progrès et quêtes du jeu.
Ceci n'est pas fait manuellement, vérifiez le guide de configuration.

options.name: Filler Items
options.doc:
Items to use as filler.
Items must be in format <amount> <item_name>: <weight>
Example: 1 minecraft:iron_ingot: 1

options.name: Quests Give Rewards
options.doc:
Whether to give a reward when getting an ftb quests check.
When off:
 - quest rewards will behave as you would normally expect from ftb quests (granted for completing quests).
 - only quests that have dependants or quest chapters will have checks associated with them.

When on:
 - receiving a ftb quest check will grant the reward associated with the
quest instead of being able to get them by completing the quest.
 - adds filler checks for quests that have no dependants.

options.name: Advancements Give Rewards
options.doc:
Whether to give a reward when getting an advancement check.
When off:
 - advancement rewards will behave as expected in vanilla.
 - only advancements that have dependants or advancement tabs will have checks associated with them.
When on:
 - advancement rewards will behave as expected in vanilla (ie. still get xp for Return to Sender).
 - advancement checks will grant a reward based on the advancement icon.
 - adds filler checks for advancements that have no dependants.

options.name: Are Better Questing Quest Rewards Randomized
options.doc:
Whether to give a reward when getting an better questing check.
When off:
 - quest rewards will behave as you would normally expect from better questing (granted for completing quests).
 - only quests that have dependants or quest chapters will have checks associated with them.

When on:
 - receiving a better questing check will grant the reward associated with the
quest instead of being able to get them by completing the quest.
 - adds filler checks for quests that have no dependants.

options.name: Start Inventory
options.doc:
Start with the specified amount of these items.
Format: "<type> <item_name> (<display_name>)": 1
Example: {"adv minecraft:story/root (Minecraft)": 1, "adv minecraft:adventure/root (Adventure)": 1}
^^^ This starts you with the root of the story advancement tab and the root of the adventure advancement tab
Type one of [adv, ftb, item]

Format: "<type> <item_name> (<display_name>)": 1 Example: {"adv minecraft:story/root (Minecraft)": 1, "adv minecraft:adventure/root (Adventure)": 1} ^^^ This starts you with the root of the story advancement tab and the root of the adventure advancement tab Type one of [adv, ftb, item]

The game decides what the replacement items will be.
